request: Migrate WordPress learner history into the feat/academy-v2 administrator
title: Expose and safely supplement WordPress learning history in admin
purpose: Connect legacy learning records to existing member administration without overwriting newer activity

files.purpose: Make imported lesson completions and quiz attempts visible in the existing member detail design.
files.previous_behavior: Member detail displayed enrollment progress and certificates only.
files.new_behavior: Adds lesson history and quiz score/result/time tables, empty states, KST dates and unknown-source-time labels.
files.data_impact: Read-only display of existing Progress and QuizAttempt relationships; no writes.
files.access_control_impact: No roles, user accounts, permissions or authentication are changed. Admin reads remain behind member.read; CLI uses operator-supplied DB credentials.
risks: Members with very large histories render more table rows; no browser visual verification was possible while DB was offline.
files.rollback: Revert this commit. No schema changes. If --apply was later executed, compare against the pre-import pg_dump in an isolated DB and restore only affected history; preserve subsequent learner activity.

files.purpose: Provide the existing member detail page with lesson and quiz history.
files.previous_behavior: Selected member profile, enrollments and certificates without learning detail.
files.new_behavior: Also selects member-scoped lesson progress and quiz attempts with associated program titles, sorted newest first.
files.data_impact: Additional read-only Prisma relations; no schema or data writes.
files.access_control_impact: No roles, user accounts, permissions or authentication are changed. Admin reads remain behind member.read; CLI uses operator-supplied DB credentials.
risks: Query volume grows with member history size; live query performance remains unverified.
files.rollback: Revert this commit. No schema changes. If --apply was later executed, compare against the pre-import pg_dump in an isolated DB and restore only affected history; preserve subsequent learner activity.

files.purpose: Provide a non-destructive history-only supplement instead of rerunning the account/content importer.
files.previous_behavior: File did not exist in the baseline commit.
files.new_behavior: Defaults to reconciliation; explicit --apply merges history in a serializable transaction, preserves newer progress, matches existing attempts and reports unmapped records without personal data.
files.data_impact: Only source-only mode was executed, reading backup history. Future --apply can insert/update Enrollment and Progress and insert QuizAttempt; no deletion, account modification or certificate issuance.
files.access_control_impact: No roles, user accounts, permissions or authentication are changed. Admin reads remain behind member.read; CLI uses operator-supplied DB credentials.
risks: Live transaction, concurrent execution and repeat-run reconciliation were not exercised because Docker/WSL was unavailable. Source timestamps require a verified offset. Missing users/curricula are reported rather than fabricated.
files.rollback: Revert this commit. No schema changes. If --apply was later executed, compare against the pre-import pg_dump in an isolated DB and restore only affected history; preserve subsequent learner activity.

symbols: node:test history parser and merge tests
files.purpose: Check malformed input handling, timestamp policy and preservation of newer learning history.
files.previous_behavior: File did not exist in the baseline commit.
files.new_behavior: Five deterministic tests cover multiline batches, escaping, truncated or executable values, missing dates, timezone conversion and monotonic enrollment merge.
files.data_impact: Synthetic in-memory fixtures only; operational data is not modified.
files.access_control_impact: No roles, user accounts, permissions or authentication are changed. Admin reads remain behind member.read; CLI uses operator-supplied DB credentials.
risks: Tests do not replace a live PostgreSQL dry-run, transactional apply and repeat-run test.
files.rollback: Revert this commit. No schema changes. If --apply was later executed, compare against the pre-import pg_dump in an isolated DB and restore only affected history; preserve subsequent learner activity.

files.purpose: Read the existing SQL backup without requiring restored MySQL or executing SQL.
files.previous_behavior: File did not exist in the baseline commit.
files.new_behavior: Parses allowlisted history tables, validates row shape, decodes escaped strings and merges enrollment progress without regression; requires explicit quiz timestamp offset.
files.data_impact: In-memory parsing only; no database access or writes.
files.access_control_impact: No roles, user accounts, permissions or authentication are changed. Admin reads remain behind member.read; CLI uses operator-supplied DB credentials.
risks: Parser supports the checked-in backup format and fails closed on unsupported value expressions; other dump formats need separate verification.
files.rollback: Revert this commit. No schema changes. If --apply was later executed, compare against the pre-import pg_dump in an isolated DB and restore only affected history; preserve subsequent learner activity.

production_safety.operational_data: Read the local WordPress backup only. No target or production DB data was read or changed because the local Docker/WSL engine was unavailable; no --apply was executed.
production_safety.schema_migration: None: existing Prisma models are used without schema changes. Optional future explicit --apply is an additive history backfill with monotonic progress updates.
external_side_effects: Attempted to start local Docker Desktop; engine failed to boot. WSL service restart failed for insufficient privileges. No remote server access, deployment, messages or external account changes.

residual_risks: Actual migration into 127.0.0.1:5433/bayada_v2 is pending Docker/WSL recovery and verified source timezone; code completion must not be reported as data migration completion.
Live PostgreSQL transaction/idempotency, query performance and rendered admin tables remain unverified.
Admin lint is unavailable until the project supplies an ESLint flat configuration.
Deleted users and missing curricula are skipped and counted. Individual answer bodies and new certificate issuance are outside this history supplement.
The 2026-10-26 backup does not include subsequent WordPress activity.
